actual_scope: Exact closed-cube-covering-walk flip threshold C(k)=2 ceil(2^(k-1)/k), balanced unsigned connector source-capacity lower bound, and one literal nine-source certificate.
scope_change_reason: The operation alphabet stays fixed. This takes PR6107 Open next question 3 and builds on PR6071 rather than adding an operation. It is a scoped local interface side result, not a completed supplier or a scientific audit.

stop_rule: Stop at the first verified balanced-walk threshold and literal connector improvement; leave other walks and unrestricted words open.
